title: Pool Chemistry Drift After Fill
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pool:chemistry event=manual_test
| where hours_since_fill<48
| stats avg(ph) as avg_ph, avg(fc_ppm) as avg_fc_ppm by pool
| where avg_ph>7.8 OR avg_fc_ppm<2
| sort - avg_ph
description: Uses Pool chemistry tests telemetry to monitor early post-fill chemistry stability in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for fill events that need faster balancing, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Pool chemistry tests data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Pool table of post-fill pH and free chlorine.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals early post-fill chemistry stability so you can spot fill events that need faster balancing before it becomes annoying.
